values: Part II whole effluent toxicity testing requirements
Permit effective date and its relationship to Federal FY2025

grounding.excerpt: *9      Monitoring and reporting requirements begin on the effective date of this permit. See PART II, Whole Effluent Toxicity testing requirements for additional WET monitoring and reporting conditions, and a frequency reduction option.

payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether Part I's Daphnia pulex once-per-quarter WET requirement (24-hour composite; report NOEC) applies at that stated frequency throughout Federal FY2025, or is modified, reduced, or suspended by additional conditions referenced in footnote *9 and specified in Part II. The packet establishes only the Part I table entry (Once/Quarter for Daphnia pulex) and footnote *9, which explicitly cross-references Part II for additional WET monitoring/reporting conditions and a frequency reduction option, and ties commencement to the permit effective date. Part II text, the permit effective date, and any FY2025 temporal mapping are not present in the packet. ACCEPT would require establishing that the Part I frequency applies unchanged throughout FY2025; footnote *9's directive to Part II and its frequency-reduction option block that conclusion from this evidence alone. REJECT would require establishing that the requirement is modified, reduced, or suspended for FY2025; without Part II or effective-date grounding, no such modification can be established. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure; neither burden is met.
